Name: Fallout Consumables
Author: Kalidi
Description:
This mod replaces some foods and forage with items from the Fallout series.

Here's my other Fallout themed mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40856]Fallout Outfits[/url].
